## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### Through an API

api (Replicate) · $0.11/M blended · $0.06 in / $0.25 out per 1M tokens · [replicate.com](https://replicate.com/ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b)

<sub>[price source](https://replicate.com/ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b): USD per 1M tokens, Replicate official model ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b, billed per input/output token (billing table on the model page: $0.06 per million input tokens, $0.25 per million output tokens; A100 80GB backing hardware not billed separately for this official model). IBM watsonx lists granite-4-1-8b as not available for pay-per-token. Currency: USD. Replicate official model page, observed 2026-09-25. · [context source](https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b/blob/1504002f650e656a0a3789d99574df12e3e94ed0/README.md): IBM official model card (ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b, pinned): architecture table 'Sequence length 131072' for the 8B Dense model; the card calls it a long-context instruct model. Observed 2026-09-25.</sub>

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run Granite 4.1 8B (Q4_K_M, needs ~5.35 GB, from [huggingface.co/ibm-granite](https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b-GGUF/tree/865b82c2e7970d82e3731278c88c57ae7138359c))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (~9.35 GB) `llama cli -hf ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b-GGUF:Q8_0`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run Granite 4.1 8B (Q4_K_M, needs ~5.35 GB, from [huggingface.co/ibm-granite](https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b-GGUF/tree/865b82c2e7970d82e3731278c88c57ae7138359c))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: Q8_0 (~9.35 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b-GGUF@Q8_0 -y` · 4bit (~5.2 GB, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/granite-4.1-8b-4bit -y` · 8bit (~9.4 GB, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/granite-4.1-8b-8bit -y`

### Ollama

1. Install Ollama. [Download it (macOS / Windows)](https://ollama.com/download)
   
   ```sh
   # Linux
   curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
   ```

2. Run Granite 4.1 8B (Q4_K_M, needs ~5.35 GB, from [ollama.com](https://ollama.com/library/granite4.1/tags))
   
   ```sh
   ollama run granite4.1:8b
   ```

### MLX (Mac)

1. Install MLX (Mac). Apple silicon Macs only, text only.
   
   ```sh
   # with uv
   uv tool install mlx-lm
   # or
   pip install mlx-lm
   ```

2. Run Granite 4.1 8B (4bit, needs ~5.2 GB, Mac only, from [huggingface.co/mlx-community](https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/granite-4.1-8b-4bit/tree/08fb1e272f7bd49fa83ce279bbdc496c980380ac))
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.chat --model mlx-community/granite-4.1-8b-4bit
   ```

3. Or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.server --model mlx-community/granite-4.1-8b-4bit
   ```

Other versions: 8bit (~9.4 GB, Mac only) `mlx_lm.chat --model mlx-community/granite-4.1-8b-8bit`

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/ibm-granite](https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b)
